name: recall_boundary_comparison
about: A comparison loses its equals sign, so exactly-18 is now rejected. Small diffs hide the easiest bugs to miss.
diff:
diff --git a/eligibility.py b/eligibility.py
--- a/eligibility.py
+++ b/eligibility.py
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
 def is_adult(age):
-    return age >= 18
+    return age > 18

findings.title: Users aged exactly 18 are now rejected
